description: Queries and updates Salesforce records via the REST API. Receives inbound data specifying what to query or modify, executes the operation, and pushes results downstream.

config.label: Domain
config.description: Salesforce instance domain, e.g. myorg.my.salesforce.com. Do not include the https:// prefix.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: OAuth 2.0 client_id from the connected app configuration in Salesforce Setup.

config.label: Client Secret
config.description: OAuth 2.0 client_secret from the connected app configuration.

config.label: Key
config.description: Pre-existing bearer token. If set, the adapter uses this token directly instead of authenticating via client_credentials. Leave empty for normal OAuth flow.

config.label: API Version
config.description: Salesforce REST API version number, e.g. 59.0. Used to build the /services/data/v<version>/ path.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, API requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime. Authentication is always performed live so credential problems surface immediately.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the Salesforce server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing.
